one_liner_zh: 通用汽車上季 EPS 2.51 美元超預期10.7%、營收 453 億美元，獲利韌性延續。
one_liner_en: GM beat EPS at $2.51 by 10.7% on $45.29B revenue, extending its profit resilience.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 超預期 10.65%，獲利優於估計（營收年增率未提供）。
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏正：EPS 連續超預期顯示燃油車獲利與成本紀律穩固。短期財報利多支撐股價，惟汽車為週期性產業，市場將留意需求與定價趨勢。中期追蹤北美利潤率、電動車虧損收斂進度、回購對 EPS 的支撐，以及關稅與利率對銷量的影響。30倍本益比限制估值上行空間。
ai_view_en: Signal is mildly positive: a repeat EPS beat shows solid ICE profitability and cost discipline. Near term the beat supports the stock, though as a cyclical, the market watches demand and pricing trends. Mid term, track North America margins, EV loss narrowing, buyback support to EPS, and the impact of tariffs and rates on volume. A ~30x P/E caps valuation upside.
highlights_zh: EPS 2.51 美元，超預期 10.65%，獲利穩健
營收 453 億美元，規模龐大
北美卡車與 SUV 維持高獲利貢獻
持續執行成本與資本紀律
highlights_en: EPS of $2.51 beat by 10.65%, solid profitability
North America trucks and SUVs sustain high profit contribution
risks_zh: 本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限
電動車轉型投資與虧損壓力
利率、關稅與消費需求的週期性風險
risks_en: Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility
EV transition investment and loss pressure
Cyclical risk from rates, tariffs and consumer demand
